greet.promise: I read your books but never change them without asking.

suggestion.spend: What did I spend last month?

tabQuestion.reports: What did I spend last month?

empty.ask: Ask me anything about your books.

create.quote: I can open a fresh quotation for you to fill in.
create.purchaseOrder: I can open a purchase order for you to fill in.
create.purchaseBill: I can open a purchase bill; you add the supplier and lines.
create.expense: I can open a new expense for you.
create.payment: I can open a payment receipt so you can record what came in.
create.supplier: I can open a new supplier for you.
create.customer: I can open a new customer; the GSTIN fills in their state.
create.item: I can open a new item; give it an HSN/SAC so GST lands on the right slab.
create.invoice: I can open a new tax invoice. I won't finalise it for you — you'll pick the customer and items and issue it yourself.

gst.missing_other: {{count}} documents need an e-way bill and don't have one.

thanks.reply: Anytime. I am one tap away in the middle of the bar.

fallback.text: I didn't catch that. I'm best with sales, who owes you, what you owe, stock, spending, GST and e-way bills — or give me a document number or a party's name.

upsell.text: {{module}} isn't part of {{plan}}, so I have nothing to read there. {{fullPlan}} adds buying, stock and expenses to the same books.
